title: tk sandbox worker-prompt's template still lacks the headless and no-amend lines tick 060 added to the cloud role prompts
body: The shared worker template behind `tk sandbox worker-prompt` (ticks' internal/herd/spawn BuildPrompt) carries neither the "ending your turn ends the job / never wait on a background task" line nor the "do not amend, rebase or reset commits you have already made" line. ticfac's cloud role prompts now carry both, so factory-dispatched workers (TICKS_ROLE_PROMPT, which wins verbatim) get them — but a cloud worker booted by hand, or dispatched by a factory that predates the role-prompt field, falls back to the checkout-rendered prompt and still runs without them.
